note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(灾难求生主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: When the typhoon warning came on the radio, the Chen family did not wait. Having packed a survival kit the week before, they quickly moved to a shelter on higher ground. The next morning, their whole street was under water, but every member of the family was safe and dry.

questions.q: Why was the Chen family able to act so quickly?
options: They had prepared a survival kit in advance.
They lived right next to the shelter.
The police carried them out by car.
They had never heard the warning before.
questions.explanation: 原文 'Having packed a survival kit the week before' 的转述;事先备好包,所以行动迅速。

questions.q: What happened to their street the next morning?
options: It was covered with flood water.
It was completely dry and clear.
It was filled with cheering crowds.
It was blocked by fallen trees only.
questions.explanation: 末句 'their whole street was under water' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
